description.short: Read tenant/user Copilot balances and spending policies as the signed-in user.
description.full: Internal read-only evaluation plugin with an integrated credit-management skill and an OAuth-protected Azure-hosted MCP connector. Reads tenant credit balances, spending-policy pages and a user's per-service balance data through the signed-in caller's delegated Microsoft Graph access. Missing quantities are not inferred and pagination remains explicit. This release has three read tools; per-user data requires additional delegated UserData administrator consent. No group enumeration or write operations are enabled. New endpoint availability and the real user-data read must be verified in Cowork.

agentConnectors.description: Read tenant credit balances, spending policies and a user's per-service balances using the signed-in caller's delegated Microsoft Graph access. UserData read consent is required for user balances. This connector is read-only.
